title: bn254-gt-dlp: (6,2) STNFS with factor-base bound 2^58, run gate, log phase at its modeled expectation: 2^91.171061368

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x with g^x=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64) 2^92.500391075 < 2^91.171061368 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). This is an expectation over the gate coin, the challenge and the run, not a bound on every run. A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7340938851697907818, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.980015 >= 0.39; a closed run is a failure costing 1 unit. In an opened run both individual logarithms run under one combined hard phase meter of 2^106 units that aborts as failure. The ledger charges the logarithm phase at its modeled expectation, E[D] <= 2^90.883942 units from the descent recurrence (H5), not at the meter, so the expected-work bound depends on the descent model, as does the success bound: by the two-variable Samuels bound of proof.md section 7 on the two independent logarithm works P(cap) <= 0.000028159, the model gives opened-run success 0.998001, and with every modeled failure term (cap loss included) multiplied by 10 it is still at least 0.980015, the figure the gate uses. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes the 171 earlier entered-node PGF strata, which the default run also replays. part=h5 recomputes ADAPTIVE.md's conditional next-relation tables (627 attempts after an earlier failed relation, failure and child-work observed/envelope with root-cluster bootstrap) from h5data.b85; the default run checks the totals. These are toy-scale measurements; transfer to production sizes is H5. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim. part=plan prints the current 62-row plan row by row (method, windows, radius, mu, psi, phi, retry, work) with the node budget, E[N] and the abort/repeat losses.
